title: Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #3

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Nullifiers of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Nullifiers of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Nullifiers of Swalah.
   C. Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Nullifiers of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Gratitude? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Hadith on Gratitude to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Gratitude.
   D. Say Hadith on Gratitude has no place in daily life.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

4. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. Which response best shows understanding of Taraweeh and Witr? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taraweeh and Witr has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taraweeh and Witr.
   C. Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Taraweeh and Witr to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.

8. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

9. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   B. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
   C. Use Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets has no place in daily life.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Selected Surah: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah:.
   C. Use Selected Surah: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Al-Isra wal Miraj 03 7.2 Pledges of Aqabah 03 7.3 Hijra to Madina 03 7.4 Constit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Al-Isra wal Miraj and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Pledges of Aqabah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Hijra to Madina 03 7.4 Constitution of Madina 03 Total Number of Lessons 90 Page and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Apply the teaching of Nullifiers of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

2. A — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Gratitude with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. B — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

4. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. C — Apply the teaching of Taraweeh and Witr with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. C — Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

9. B — Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Apply the teaching of Selected Surah: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. D — Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Pledges of Aqabah; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hijra to Madina 03 7.4 Constitution of Madina 03 Total Number of Lessons 90 Page; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
